$schema_note: Capability status manifest per the P1 closure program vocabulary. Axes: designed, code_complete, deployed (on prod head), enabled (flags/config on), exercised (real controlled use), approved (customer/operator validated), generally_available (all tenants, no gate). Evidence basis: exact head 0a5741fdb4d92ff8f776ebe4736e03ccfa6626d3, hosted migration parity 0133, read-only hosted checks 2026-07-18. Never treat designed/code_complete/deployed as live.
$retired_axis_note: TERMINAL STATE, added 2026-07-29. The 7 axes above form a progress ladder with no rejection state, so a permanently-cancelled capability would otherwise sit mid-ladder and read as pending. An entry carrying "retired": true is a CLOSED PRODUCT DECISION: it is NOT parked, dormant, held, deferred or awaiting approval, and the remaining axes are historical facts about what was once built, never a to-do list. "retired": true overrides every other axis for planning purposes; no work may be opened against it and it maps to no roadmap ID. Reversal requires a new explicit product decision, architecture review, legal/privacy review, migration plan and fresh acceptance -- not a flag flip. Each retired entry names its decision record in "retired_decision_record".
amended: 2026-07-29 -- clinical_finalization_amendments moved to the terminal retired state (see $retired_axis_note). No other entry changed.

clinical_finalization_amendments.notes: RETIRED -- TERMINAL. Signed/cryptographically finalized clinical records are NOT a Hone product capability. Permanently rejected: practitioner-signed snapshots, immutable finalized records, snapshot v2, cryptographic clinical-record hashes as a product feature, and any correction/amendment workflow built around signed snapshots. Treatment sessions remain ORDINARY EDITABLE operational records; practitioners correct mistakes by editing. This entry is NOT parked, dormant, held or awaiting customer approval of a UI -- the previous note said 'parked pending customer approval of UI', which is superseded. The axes below are historical: 0119/0120 were built and deployed, and Phase 1 was exercised exactly once on a controlled non-Willow test studio (1 finalized session of 76, 1 snapshot whose content_hash still re-derives, retained unchanged and deliberately neither deleted nor regenerated); Phase 2 was never exercised (0 amendments, 0 clinical_audit_events); Willow has 0 non-draft sessions. 'enabled': false is now permanent and 'enabled_possible': false records that no role can change it: migration 0159 pins clinical_finalization_enabled and clinical_corrections_enabled false with CHECK constraints, revokes EXECUTE on finalize_session/correct_finalized_session/amend_finalized_session/amend_finalized_session_with_image/build_session_snapshot from every runtime role, refuses any sessions.record_status transition into finalized/void, and refuses INSERT into clinical_record_snapshots/clinical_record_amendments/clinical_audit_events. 0159 drops nothing and performs zero data operations; hosted max is still 0157 and 0158 is intentionally skipped. RETAINED and not weakened: ordinary operational audit (session_audit, record_keeping_audit_events, session_copy_operations, admin_action_events, client_portal_access_events), actor attribution, timestamps, treatment-history integrity, whole-session-copy provenance, tenant isolation. clinical_audit_events is NOT ordinary audit -- its CHECK admits only operation_type correction/amendment, so it is retired with the rest. Roadmap SEC-09 is retired in place; no work maps to this entry. Unrelated and NOT retired: append-only clinical NOTES (client_clinical_notes, 0126/0127), where a correction is a new row.
